combo_box.name: PlusShadowDistance
combo_box.tool_tip: How far the sun's shadows reach, and how sharp they stay there. Far and Very far use finer shadow maps (more video memory).

combo_box.name: PlusShadowPrecision
combo_box.tool_tip: How thin a shadow (legs, railings, hair) stays at a distance. Fine and Very fine use finer shadow maps (more video memory).

combo_box.name: PlusShadowFocus
combo_box.tool_tip: Where the finest shadows go. The subject: your avatar (or what the camera is pointed at) and its shadow get the finest shadow map the screen allows, wherever it stands; things much nearer or farther get coarser ones. Snapshots always use the subject.

combo_box.name: PlusShadowSoftness
combo_box.tool_tip: How sharp or soft the edges of the sun's shadows are. Kept in snapshots; does not change the preset in use.

slider.tool_tip: Controls at what point a visually complex avatar is drawn as a JellyDoll
slider.label: Maximum complexity:
slider.name: IndirectMaxComplexity

check_box.label: Enable Texture Compression (requires restart)
check_box.name: texture compression
check_box.tool_tip: Compresses textures in video memory, allowing for higher resolution textures to be loaded at the cost of some color quality.

check_box.label: Temporal AA (TAA: smooths thin lines)
check_box.name: taa
check_box.tool_tip: Temporal anti-aliasing: mixes the last few frames into this one, so thin lines and edges that stay jagged or flicker smooth out where the view is still. It comes after the anti-aliasing above, which stays as it is set (FXAA or SMAA and TAA are both used). Moving things may leave a faint trail. Saved snapshots are taken without it. Light; takes effect at once, no restart.

check_box.label: Enable support for HiDPI displays (requires restart)
check_box.name: use HiDPI

spinner.label: Frame rate limit (0 = none):
spinner.name: fpslimit
spinner.tool_tip: The most frames per second the viewer makes. 0 = no limit. Lowers the load and heat of the graphics card when VSync is off. With VSync on, a value above the monitor's refresh rate does nothing.

button.label: Match
button.name: fpslimit_match
button.tool_tip: Match the monitor's refresh rate: sets the limit to the refresh rate of the monitor this window is on. With VSync on, a 59.94 Hz style rate (59, 119, 143, 239 as Windows reports it) is set one higher (60, 120, 144, 240), so that VSync sets the pace without a hitch.

check_box.label: Enable VSync
check_box.name: vsync
check_box.tool_tip: Synchronizes the frame rate to the refresh rate of the monitor, which results in smooth performance.

combo_box.name: MaxTextureResolution
combo_box.tool_tip: Maximum resolution for 'level of detail' textures

slider.label: Tone Mapping Mix:
slider.tool_tip: Mix between linear and tone mapped colors
slider.name: TonemapMix

check_box.label: Enable depth of field (the view is blurred except where the camera is focused)
check_box.name: UseDoF

check_box.label: Also while editing
check_box.name: RenderDepthOfFieldInEditMode
check_box.tool_tip: Keeps depth of field on while you build or edit objects.

slider.label: Camera f-number:
slider.name: CameraFNum
slider.tool_tip: The f-number of the camera for depth of field: lower blurs more of what is out of focus.

slider.label: Focal length (mm):
slider.name: CameraFocal
slider.tool_tip: The focal length of the camera for depth of field, in millimetres.

slider.label: Field of view (degrees):
slider.name: Camera FOV
slider.tool_tip: The vertical field of view of the camera for depth of field, in degrees.

slider.label: Focus transition time:
slider.name: CameraFocusTrans
slider.tool_tip: How long the focus takes to move from one place to the next, in seconds.

slider.label: Depth of field quality:
slider.name: CameraDoFResScale
slider.tool_tip: The quality of the blur: higher looks better, lower is faster.

combo_box.name: PlusUpscale
combo_box.tool_tip: Draws the world smaller than the window and brings it up to the window's size, for more frames per second where the graphics card sets the pace. The HUD, name tags and the UI stay sharp; snapshots are taken at the full size, and while the photo screen or the photo tools (not minimized) are open the world is drawn at the full size too, so the frame rate drops there.

slider.label: Render scale:
slider.name: PlusUpscaleScale
slider.tool_tip: The share of the window's width and height the world is drawn at: 0.77 quality, 0.67 balanced, 0.59 faster, 0.5 fastest.

slider.label: Sharpening:
slider.name: PlusUpscaleSharpness
slider.tool_tip: How much the upscaled picture is sharpened (0: not at all, 1: the most). A matter of taste.

check_box.label: GTAO (finer shade in corners)
check_box.name: PlusGtao
check_box.tool_tip: Ground-truth ambient occlusion in place of the standard one: the shade in corners, under furniture and where surfaces meet. Needs Screen Space Ambient Occlusion (General tab), which it replaces. Costs graphics card time (see the quality).

combo_box.name: PlusGtaoQuality
combo_box.tool_tip: Low and Medium work on a quarter of the pixels (8 and 24 samples); High on every pixel. Higher is finer and slower.

slider.label: GTAO strength:
slider.name: PlusGtaoStrength
slider.tool_tip: How dark occluded places get: 1 as measured, 2 darker, 0 none.

slider.label: GTAO reach (m):
slider.name: PlusGtaoRadius
slider.tool_tip: How far away a surface still shades another, in metres. Larger: broader, softer shade.

check_box.label: Indirect light (SSGI)
check_box.name: PlusSsgi
check_box.tool_tip: The colour of nearby lit surfaces (sunny ground, a red wall) comes back into the shade beside them. Needs GTAO, Screen Space Ambient Occlusion, HDR and the reflection probes.

slider.label: Indirect light strength:
slider.name: PlusSsgiStrength
slider.tool_tip: How much of the light nearby surfaces send back is added (1: all that is gathered).

check_box.label: Reflections: New Method
check_box.name: PlusSSR
check_box.tool_tip: Screen-space reflections, new method: reflections reach farther, and slightly rough floors get blurred ones too. Needs Screen Space Reflections (General tab) on. A little slower. Glass, alpha and water keep the standard reflections.

combo_box.name: OITMode
combo_box.tool_tip: Draws overlapping transparent surfaces (hair, eyelashes, glass, smoke) in their true order, so hair edges no longer cut holes in what is behind them. Grayed out on graphics cards that lack the features OIT needs.

check_box.label: Take snapshots with full OIT
check_box.name: OITSnapshotFull
check_box.tool_tip: Snapshots are rendered with OIT on everything, whatever the setting above is. Slower to take.

check_box.label: Materialize objects as their textures arrive
check_box.name: PlusMaterialize
check_box.tool_tip: While its textures load, an object is drawn as glowing lines; when they arrive, a band of light sweeps up it and leaves the real surfaces behind. Objects whose textures are already at hand (the cache) show at once, without it. Needs the wireframe while textures load (the debug setting RenderGrayTextureWireframe, on by default).

slider.label: Materialize time (s):
slider.name: PlusMaterializeSeconds
slider.tool_tip: How long the band of light takes to sweep from the bottom of an object to its top, in seconds.

combo_box.name: PlusMaterializePalette
combo_box.tool_tip: The colour of the lines and of the band of light. Custom: the colour of the swatch on the right.

color_swatch.name: PlusMaterializeColor
color_swatch.tool_tip: A colour of your own for the lines and the band of light. Picking one sets the glow colour to Custom. Its brightness is used as it is; a colour close to black gives cyan.

check_box.label: Materialize avatars too
check_box.name: PlusMaterializeAvatar
check_box.tool_tip: An avatar drawn as glowing lines while it loads (yours after login, others whose clothes are not loaded yet) is swept once by the band of light from its feet to its head when it has everything, and the real body, clothes and attachments appear. Up to 8 avatars at once; avatars already at hand show at once.

check_box.label: Crumble objects as they vanish
check_box.name: PlusDerez
check_box.tool_tip: When an object near you is deleted or returned (yours or someone else's), it breaks into small glowing cubes that drift up and fade, instead of vanishing at once. Not for attachments, avatars, physical objects or teleports.

slider.label: Crumble time (s):
slider.name: PlusDerezSeconds
slider.tool_tip: How long a vanishing object takes to crumble away, in seconds.

combo_box.name: PlusDerezPalette
combo_box.tool_tip: The colour of the glowing edge where the object breaks apart. Custom: the colour of the swatch on the right.

color_swatch.name: PlusDerezColor
color_swatch.tool_tip: A glow colour of your own for objects that crumble away. Picking one sets the glow colour to Custom.
